panel.label: General
panel.name: graphics_general_panel

check_box.label: Use exact transparency (OIT)
check_box.name: RenderExactOIT
check_box.tool_tip: On: correctly composite overlapping transparent surfaces. Off: use legacy alpha blending, which may be faster in scenes with heavy transparency but can show sorting artifacts. Changes apply immediately.

panel.text: Turn off to use legacy rendering in scenes with heavy transparency.

slider.label: Avatar maximum complexity:
slider.name: IndirectMaxComplexity
slider.tool_tip: Controls at what point a visually complex avatar is drawn as a JellyDoll

check_box.label: Do not render attached lights on avatars
check_box.name: BoxxyDisableAvatarAttachedLights
check_box.tool_tip: Stops lights from avatar attachments from illuminating the scene.

check_box.label: Do not render attached particles on avatars
check_box.name: BoxxyDisableAvatarAttachedParticles
check_box.tool_tip: Stops particle systems emitted by avatar attachments from rendering.

panel.name: SkinScatteringContent
panel.text: Softens lighting on surfaces tagged [sss] in the linkset description (or attachment name when no description is available).

check_box.label: Enable skin subsurface scattering
check_box.name: BoxxySSSEnabled
check_box.tool_tip: Apply skin lighting to visible [sss]-tagged surfaces, including test prims. The default avatar mesh is excluded.

combo_box.name: BoxxySSSMode
combo_box.tool_tip: Combined adds adjustable wrap and warm backlighting to screen diffusion. Wrapped lighting has the lowest GPU cost.

check_box.label: Maximum quality (screenshots)
check_box.name: BoxxySSSFullResolution
check_box.tool_tip: Use full-resolution diffusion and transmission blur in Screen diffusion and Combined modes. Very GPU intensive at large radii and close zoom. Applies immediately; leave off for everyday use.

slider.label: Strength:
slider.name: BoxxySSSStrength
slider.tool_tip: Controls how strongly skin lighting wraps and diffuses.

slider.label: Diffusion depth (m):
slider.name: BoxxySSSDepth
slider.tool_tip: Sets how far illumination spreads across visible skin in Screen diffusion and Combined modes. Larger radii increase GPU work.

slider.label: Skin tone response:
slider.name: BoxxySSSWarmth
slider.tool_tip: Shared tone control: warms wrapped light, favors red transmission, and spreads red diffuse light farther than blue. It affects all three scattering components.

slider.label: Maximum distance (m):
slider.name: BoxxySSSMaxDistance
slider.tool_tip: Limits skin scattering to nearby affected surfaces to control GPU cost.

slider.label: Combined wrap:
slider.name: BoxxySSSWrapAmount
slider.tool_tip: Adds wrapped lighting in Combined mode. Zero leaves diffusion and transmission.

slider.label: Transmission brightness:
slider.name: BoxxySSSTransmission
slider.tool_tip: Linearly scales shine-through brightness without changing the penetration limit. Increase to brighten thin areas such as ears.

slider.label: Local transmission boost:
slider.name: BoxxySSSPointTransmissionBoost
slider.tool_tip: Extra multiplier for point-light and projector shine-through. 1 is neutral; try 4 for stronger transmission. Leaves front lighting and sun/moon unchanged. Works with both measured and estimated thickness; blocked paths remain dark.

slider.label: Optical absorption:
slider.name: BoxxySSSThickness
slider.tool_tip: Controls absorption in both transmission modes. Zero disables absorption; lower values transmit more light. Estimated mode uses a fixed rounded 8.5 mm reference layer. Measured transmission still requires a valid path within the penetration limit.

check_box.label: Use depth-based transmission
check_box.name: BoxxySSSShadowThickness
check_box.tool_tip: Combined mode: verify matching skin entry and exit surfaces near a selected subject within 32 m. Opaque clothing and gaps between layers block transmission. Coverage and subject/light changes fade smoothly. Works with Shadows set to None. Turn off to use estimated thickness.

slider.label: Penetration limit (mm):
slider.name: BoxxySSSPenetration
slider.tool_tip: Maximum verified light path through skin. Light fades gradually across the entire range and reaches zero at this limit. Lower values suppress thicker regions. Requires depth-based transmission; estimated mode is unaffected.

slider.label: Transmission blur (mm):
slider.name: BoxxySSSTransmissionSmoothing
slider.tool_tip: Smooths transmitted light after lighting, with skin and depth checks at edges. Gentler normal filtering reduces mottling on uneven meshes. Textures and specular highlights stay sharp. Zero disables the extra transmission filtering.

check_box.label: Include point-light depth (experimental)
check_box.name: BoxxySSSPointDepth
check_box.tool_tip: Include point lights in the shared two-light depth budget near the closest affected subject. Adds depth rendering and sampling work. Toggle to compare performance.

check_box.label: Detect mesh body parts on all avatars
check_box.name: BoxxySSSAutoDetect
check_box.tool_tip: Detect your own and other avatars' mesh attachments when the linkset root name contains any whitelist term. Names load gradually for visible attachments within Maximum distance.

check_box.label: Highlight affected surfaces
check_box.name: BoxxySSSShowMask
check_box.tool_tip: Highlight every surface currently receiving skin scattering for setup and testing.

check_box.label: Debug transmission depth
check_box.name: BoxxySSSShowDepth
check_box.tool_tip: Choose interpolated measured depth, or the final summed transmission, including absorption, light colors, intensity, and blur. Overrides the surface highlight. Requires depth-based transmission enabled in Combined mode.

panel.text: Depth: white 0 mm; black 300 mm / blocked; magenta unavailable. Combined: transmitted light from all lights, including blur.

line_editor.name: BoxxySSSWhitelist
line_editor.tool_tip: Separate terms with commas. Matching ignores case and finds terms anywhere in the attachment root name. Empty terms are ignored.

panel.text: Comma-separated terms; body also matches eBODY. Clear the list to use only explicit [sss] tags.
Works with Shadows off. Focused depth covers nearby skin and at most two local lights; uncovered surfaces fade transmission out in depth mode. Opaque and alpha-masked surfaces only.

panel.name: graphics_pcss_panel
panel.label: PCSS
panel.text: Sun, moon and projector shadows soften as the caster moves away from the receiving surface. Minimum softness gently smooths close contacts.

check_box.name: RenderPCSSEnabled
check_box.label: Enable contact-hardening soft shadows
check_box.tool_tip: Apply PCSS to sun, moon and enabled projector shadows. Changes apply immediately.

slider.name: RenderPCSSLightSize
slider.label: Sun / moon size (degrees):
slider.tool_tip: Angular diameter of the shadow-casting light. 0.53 degrees approximates the sun. Try 1 to 3 for softer shadows; this does not resize the visible sun or moon.

slider.name: RenderPCSSProjectorSize
slider.label: Projector size (m):
slider.tool_tip: Effective light-emitter diameter for shadow-casting projectors. Larger lights soften shadows more. Requires Sun / Moon + Projectors; this does not change the light's range or beam angle.

slider.name: RenderPCSSMinSoftness
slider.label: Minimum softness (m):
slider.tool_tip: Minimum radius of a soft shadow edge, including close contacts. Start at 0.02 m; set to zero for physically sharp contact shadows. Limited by Maximum softness.

slider.name: RenderPCSSMaxSoftness
slider.label: Maximum softness (m):
slider.tool_tip: Caps the radius of the soft shadow edge in world metres. Lower values keep very distant shadows from spreading too widely.

slider.name: RenderPCSSBias
slider.label: Contact bias (mm):
slider.tool_tip: Increase if surfaces develop false self-shadow spots. Lower values keep shadows closer to their caster. Start at 5 mm.

combo_box.name: RenderPCSSQuality
combo_box.tool_tip: Higher quality smooths broad shadow edges and finds small blockers more reliably, at a higher GPU cost.

panel.text: Start with Balanced quality. Increase the light size for softer distant shadows, or Minimum softness for softer contacts. Very broad shadows may need High quality.

panel.name: graphics_gtao_panel
panel.label: GTAO
panel.text: Adds soft ambient shadowing in corners and where surfaces meet. GTAO replaces legacy SSAO while enabled and works with shadows off.

check_box.name: RenderGTAODebug
check_box.label: Debug view: white geometry with GTAO
check_box.tool_tip: Shows GTAO on white opaque and alpha-masked surfaces against a gray background. Hides textures, lighting and transparency to isolate occlusion. Resets when the viewer restarts.

slider.name: RenderGTAORadius
slider.label: Radius (m):
slider.tool_tip: Reach of nearby ambient shadows. Start at 0.50 m. Larger radii add broad shading but can create halos around thin objects.

slider.name: RenderGTAOStrength
slider.label: Strength:
slider.tool_tip: Shadow intensity. 1.00 is normal, 0 removes GTAO shadowing. Also affects the debug view.

combo_box.name: RenderGTAOQuality
combo_box.tool_tip: Higher quality reduces noise and captures small crevices more reliably, at a higher GPU cost.

slider.name: RenderGTAODenoise
slider.label: Denoising:
slider.tool_tip: Smooths noise while preserving surface edges. 1.00 is normal; 0 shows the raw samples for inspection.

slider.name: RenderGTAOFalloff
slider.label: Distance falloff:
slider.tool_tip: How much of the radius fades gradually. Higher values soften the transition and reduce distant occlusion. Start at 0.60.

slider.name: RenderGTAOThinOccluder
slider.label: Thin-object compensation:
slider.tool_tip: Increase to reduce excessive shadowing behind thin objects such as chair legs. High values can weaken real occlusion in deep corners. Start at 0.

panel.text: Start with Balanced quality and a 0.50 m radius. Use the debug view to inspect contact shadows. Transparent surfaces and objects outside the view cannot contribute occlusion.

panel.name: graphics_taa_panel
panel.label: TAA
panel.text: Temporal antialiasing smooths edges across frames. Motion tracking and history rejection help keep dancing avatars clear.

slider.name: RenderTAAHistoryWeight
slider.label: History weight:
slider.tool_tip: Maximum contribution of previous frames. Start at 0.90. Lower values respond faster but smooth less. Motion and rejected surfaces automatically use less history.

slider.name: RenderTAAMotionProtection
slider.label: Motion protection:
slider.tool_tip: Higher values favor the current image during movement and color changes, reducing trails on dancing avatars. Start at 0.85. May increase shimmer during fast motion.

slider.name: RenderTAAClipGamma
slider.label: Color clipping range:
slider.tool_tip: Lower values reject stale colors more tightly and reduce ghosting. Higher values preserve more history and smooth fine details. Start at 1.00.

slider.name: RenderTAATransparency
slider.label: Transparency protection:
slider.tool_tip: Reduces history around hair, transparent clothing, water and particles. Start at 1.00. Lower values smooth more but can leave trails.

slider.name: RenderTAASharpen
slider.label: Sharpening:
slider.tool_tip: Restores detail after temporal smoothing. Start at 0.20. This adds to any general graphics sharpening.

check_box.name: RenderTAAStaticDetails
check_box.label: Stabilize fine static details
check_box.tool_tip: Preserves thin static bars and small highlights across jitter samples while the camera is still. Animated avatars and moving objects keep strict history rejection. Removed static details can linger for up to eight frames.

panel.text: Start with the defaults. If motion leaves trails, raise motion protection or lower history weight. HUDs stay sharp. TAA pauses for snapshots and GTAO / skin debug views.
